faqs.question: I’m new to AI. Is this for me?
faqs.answer: Yes. The guide explains practical tasks through prompts, worked examples and visual guidance. Start with one task and build from there; you do not need technical jargon to begin.

faqs.question: Will this work for my type of business?
faqs.answer: The examples cover food, retail, beauty, services, freelance work and other small businesses. You can adapt the briefs and prompts to your own offer and customers.

faqs.question: Can I read it on my phone?
faqs.answer: You can read the PDF in a suitable reader on your phone. A larger screen may be more comfortable for design and video tasks. Fillable-planner support depends on your PDF reader; save and reopen a test entry first.

faqs.question: Do I need paid AI tools?
faqs.answer: The guide includes ways to start with free access where available. Features, credits and limits vary by tool and can change. Buying the PDF does not include a paid software subscription.

faqs.question: Does it include graphics and video lessons?
faqs.answer: It covers image prompting, graphic layout and Canva, plus storyboarding and Google Flow video guidance. This is an illustrated PDF guide, not a collection of video lessons. Visuals include worked examples and simplified teaching diagrams.

faqs.question: Is the campaign companion included?
faqs.answer: The main purchase includes the 44-page guide and the free 8-page planner. The 21-page 30-Day Content Campaign companion is an optional paid upgrade offered in the same Selar checkout; it is not included in the main guide price.
